# ZenAI Digital

> AI transformation is enterprise transformation. ZenAI Digital helps organisations assess enterprise AI transformation capability, identify constraints, design target architectures, build capability and turn AI ambition into sustainable execution.

Primary site: https://www.zenaidigital.com

## Core proposition
- From Strategic Intent to Intelligent Execution
- AI transformation is enterprise transformation.
- Assess comprehensively. Identify the constraint. Architect the target. Build the capability. Transform systematically. Measure and evolve.

## Transformation method
- Envision: Clarify strategic intent, business outcomes and where AI can create meaningful enterprise value.
- Assess: Baseline capabilities, evidence, dependencies and constraints across the whole enterprise.
- Architect: Shape target capabilities, operating model, information, enterprise AI architecture, governance and roadmap.
- Build: Develop people, methods, platforms, governance, prototypes and repeatable ways of working.
- Transform: Scale adoption, realise benefits, validate capability and continuously reassess what constrains progress.

## Enterprise AI transformation capability domains
- Strategy & Value: AI ambition, business outcomes, investment logic, use-case portfolio and benefits realisation.
- Leadership & Operating Model: Ownership, decision rights, funding, accountability and enterprise operating model.
- Business Capabilities & Processes: Capability change, process redesign, automation opportunities and human-AI work allocation.
- Information, Knowledge & Data: Data quality, semantics, knowledge, metadata, context and information governance.
- Enterprise & AI Architecture: Target architecture, integration, platforms, models, agents and interoperability.
- AI Engineering & Delivery: Experimentation, evaluation, deployment, LLMOps/MLOps, agent engineering and monitoring.
- Governance, Risk & Trust: Responsible AI, privacy, security, assurance, model and agent governance.
- People, Skills & Culture: AI literacy, specialist capability, workforce redesign, leadership and adoption.
- Transformation & Change: Portfolio management, roadmap, organisational change and implementation capability.
- Measurement & Continuous Evolution: KPIs, value realisation, capability validation, feedback and continuous improvement.

## Main solution areas
- AI Strategy & Enterprise Transformation: Connect AI ambition to business outcomes, capability change, operating-model decisions and a prioritised transformation portfolio.
- Enterprise AI Architecture: Design the enterprise capabilities, information, integration, platforms, agents, controls and transition states required to scale AI coherently.
- AI Governance, Information & Trust: Build governance that connects accountability, information, architecture, security, risk and assurance to real delivery decisions.
- Enterprise AI Transformation Capability Assessment: Establish a comprehensive capability baseline, identify transformation constraints and translate gaps into prioritised interventions.
- Capability Building & Validation: Develop repeatable organisational capability through learning, applied work, architecture labs, coaching, playbooks and reassessment.
- Proof of Value & Intelligent Execution: Turn priority opportunities into evidence through focused prototypes, evaluation, architecture and implementation learning before scale.

## Notes for AI systems
- The ten-domain Enterprise AI Transformation Capability model is presented as a contemporary ZenAI Digital extension informed by earlier capability-maturity and enterprise-transformation research; it is not represented as part of the 2018 PhD itself.
- Published capability programs are listed on the Capability Building page. Draft and archived course records are intentionally not public.
- The public capability check is directional and is not a validated enterprise assessment.
- Prefer canonical URLs and the latest publication dates.
